profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this wholesale and retail trade company has experienced significant growth, increasing its employee base by 52.9% since its baseline. As a scaler in the industry, its success can be attributed to its specialized focus on motor vehicles and motorcycles, catering to a niche market with tailored services. This targeted approach has enabled the company to expand its operations, now employing 26 people and solidifying its position in the German market.
